title: Denver Charter Fishing

services.name: Fishing Trips
services.desc: Denver Charter Fishing operates guided fishing and leisure boating trips on Cherry Creek and Chatfield Reservoirs aboard a brand new 2026 Bentley Legacy 220 Navigator 22 foot pontoon! This beauty has ample seating room for up to 11 people and a ton of open space. Every trip is priced as a flat rate for your entire group covering all gear, bait, fuel, and guide service. All you need to bring is your group, a valid Colorado fishing license for anyone planning to fish, and whatever food, drinks, and personal items you want on the water. We handle everything else. Our 2026 Bentley Legacy 220 Navigator Quad Lounge pontoon is purpose built for the kind of group experience Denver Charter Fishing
